title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
summary: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. Embodied agents admit no such shortcut, since they require data that couple observations with physical states and actions. These signals can be provided, to varying degrees, by multiple data sources. In this work, we organize the embodied data ecosystem as a "pyramid" spanning five complementary sources: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric data, simulation data, and general vision-language data. We organize the pyramid around the tension between scalability and robot alignment, and further characterize each source in terms of data quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity. We then analyze recent embodied foundation models through the lens of their data recipes, examining how different sources are selected, aligned, and mixed during pretraining. For embodied brain models, vision-language-action models, and world-action models alike, we relate data composition to capabilities in perception, reasoning, planning, action generation, and world prediction. We close by discussing six open challenges: building large-scale tactile datasets, collecting failure and recovery data, developing scalable data-collection pipelines, aligning actions across embodiments, leveraging egocentric data for dexterous manipulation, and designing principled data recipes for robot learning. We hope this work paves the foundation for the design of next-generation embodied systems.
tldr: This paper organizes embodied manipulation data into a five-source 'pyramid' (real-robot, UMI-style, egocentric/exocentric, simulation, general vision-language) and analyzes how recent embodied foundation models select, align, and mix these sources, discussing the trade-offs between scalability and robot alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文将具身操作数据组织成一个包含五个来源（真实机器人、UMI风格、自我中心/外部中心、仿真、通用视觉语言）的“金字塔”，并分析近期具身基础模型如何选择、对齐和混合这些数据源，讨论了可扩展性与机器人对齐之间的权衡。
summary_zh: 多模态基础模型通过消耗整个互联网数据学会了观察和言语表达。具身智能体则无法采用这种捷径，因为其所需数据必须将观测结果与物理状态和动作相耦合。这些信号可通过多种数据源以不同程度提供。在本工作中，我们将具身数据生态系统组织为涵盖五种互补来源的"金字塔"结构：真实机器人数据、UMI风格数据、以自我为中心和以他者为中心的数据、仿真数据以及通用视觉语言数据。该金字塔围绕可扩展性与机器人对齐之间的张力构建，并进一步从数据质量、多样性、可复用性和物理保真度四个维度对每种数据源进行表征。随后，我们通过数据配方的视角分析近期具身基础模型，探究不同数据源在预训练过程中如何被选择、对齐和混合。针对具身大脑模型、视觉-语言-动作模型及世界-动作模型，我们将数据构成与感知、推理、规划、动作生成和世界预测等能力建立关联。最后，我们讨论了六个开放性挑战：构建大规模触觉数据集、收集失败与恢复数据、开发可扩展的数据采集流程、实现跨具身形态的动作对齐、利用以自我为中心的数据进行灵巧操作，以及为机器人学习设计具有原则性的数据配方。我们期望这项工作能为下一代具身系统的设计奠定基础。

title: DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
summary: Generalizable robot manipulation requires policies that can anticipate how visual scenes evolve while executing language instructions. While recent Vision-Language-Action models benefit from large-scale pretraining, their predominantly static pretraining objectives provide limited supervision for physical dynamics and temporal causality, leaving control-relevant knowledge to be learned from downstream robot demonstrations. Video generative models offer a promising foundation by encoding rich spatiotemporal priors through future predictions. However, existing Video-Action Models either couple video and action prediction in a shared backbone, making policy adaptation harder to optimize, or under-utilize video information when guiding the action branch. In this work, we introduce DeVA, a Decoupled Video-Action model with specialized video and action experts, multi-level feature transfer, and physically salient guidance. DeVA transfers representations from multiple video layers to the action expert, enabling rich information exchange while making policy learning more tractable. It further supervises intermediate video features and the action stream with physically salient guidance (affordance/depth). Experiments on both simulation benchmarks and real-world deployment demonstrate strong performance with limited data, faster convergence than a unified architecture, and clear performance gains from physical guidance.
tldr: DeVA proposes a decoupled video-action model with specialized experts, multi-level feature transfer, and physical guidance (affordance/depth) for robot policy learning, achieving faster convergence and better performance with limited data.
tldr_zh: DeVA提出了一种解耦的视频-动作模型，包含专用专家、多级特征传递和物理引导（affordance/深度），用于机器人策略学习，在有限数据下实现了更快的收敛和更好的性能。
summary_zh: 通用机器人操纵需要具备这样的策略：它能够预知在执行语言指令时视觉场景如何演变。尽管近期视觉-语言-动作模型受益于大规模预训练，但其主要基于静态图像的预训练目标对物理动态和时序因果关系的监督能力有限，导致与操控相关的知识仍需从下游机器人演示中习得。视频生成模型通过未来预测编码丰富的时空先验知识，为此提供了极具潜力的基础。然而，现有视频-动作模型要么将视频与动作预测耦合在共享主干网络中，导致策略优化难度增加；要么在引导动作分支时未能充分利用视频信息。本研究提出DeVA——一种解耦式视频-动作模型，其包含专用视频专家与动作专家、多层级特征迁移机制以及物理显著性引导模块。DeVA将多个视频层的表征迁移至动作专家，在确保信息充分交换的同时降低策略学习复杂度。该模型进一步利用物理显著性引导（可交互性/深度信息）对中间视频特征及动作流进行监督。在仿真基准测试和真实场景部署中的实验表明，DeVA在有限数据下展现出强劲性能，相比统一架构具有更快的收敛速度，且物理引导模块带来了显著的性能提升。

title: FutureRTC: Real-Time Robot Execution with Anticipatory-Conditioned Action Chunking
summary: Real-time deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies necessitates asynchronous execution, wherein subsequent action chunks are computed concurrently with the execution of the current chunk, leading to prediction-execution misalignment and manifesting as inter-chunk discontinuities. Existing methods either superficially smooth chunk boundaries, require costly policy optimization, or exclusively forward-predict proprioceptive states yet neglect critical visual observations. In this paper, we propose \textbf{FutureRTC}, a plug-and-play adaptation framework that predicts execution-time observations and states for asynchronous VLA control without modifying the underlying policy. Specifically, FutureRTC features a state correction module to compensate for the discrepancy between rolled-forward and actual execution-time proprioceptive states and an observation prediction module that forecasts execution-time visual representations by leveraging robot motion as an explicit physical prior through motion-aware feature transport and reconstruction. Furthermore, we introduce a policy consistency loss to align the action chunks generated from predicted contexts with those produced under the expected execution-time inputs of the VLA policy. Extensive experiments across simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that FutureRTC achieves superior robustness to inference delays, resulting in smoother trajectories, faster execution, and consistently higher task success rates.
tldr: FutureRTC is a plug-and-play framework that predicts execution-time observations and states to mitigate prediction-execution misalignment in asynchronous VLA policy deployment, improving smoothness and task success without modifying the underlying policy.
tldr_zh: FutureRTC 是一个即插即用的框架，通过预测执行时刻的观测和状态来消除异步 VLA 策略部署中的预测-执行错位，在不修改底层策略的情况下提升平滑性和任务成功率。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的实时部署需要异步执行，即后续动作块与当前动作块的执行同时计算，这会导致预测与执行之间的错位，并表现为块间不连续性。现有方法要么仅表层地平滑块边界，要么需要昂贵的策略优化，要么仅前向预测本体感受状态而忽略关键的视觉观测。本文提出**FutureRTC**，一种即插即用的自适应框架，无需修改基础策略即可预测异步VLA控制中的执行时刻观测与状态。具体而言，FutureRTC包含一个状态校正模块，用于补偿前向递推本体感受状态与实际执行时刻本体感受状态之间的差异；以及一个观测预测模块，通过利用机器人运动作为显式物理先验，结合运动感知特征传输与重构，来预测执行时刻的视觉表征。此外，我们引入策略一致性损失，使基于预测上下文生成的动作块与基于VLA策略预期执行时刻输入生成的动作块对齐。在模拟和真实环境中的大量实验表明，FutureRTC对推理延迟具有卓越的鲁棒性，可实现更平滑的轨迹、更快的执行速度以及持续更高的任务成功率。

title: τ: Learning Touch-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Models from Future Visual Supervision
summary: Learning the informative tactile representation while effectively adapting it to pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains challenging at both the data and modeling levels. At the data level, limited task-specific demonstrations constrain representation quality, whereas large-scale pretraining incurs substantial costs. At the modeling level, existing methods either focus on instantaneous contact states or model temporal interaction dynamics using 6D wrench sequences, leaving high-dimensional tactile signals underexplored. To address these challenges, we present τ, a touch-augmented VLA framework that learns an action-conditioned spatiotemporal tactile representation from future visual supervision inspired by the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), and fuses it with vision-language features for action generation under limited data. This supervision operates in latent space and is used only during training, adding no deployment overhead. We also introduce TacAura, a dataset of synchronized vision, proprioception, and vision-based tactile signals across four representative contact-rich manipulation tasks. Experiments show that τ outperforms existing models and generalizes to unseen objects and scenes, delivering improved manipulation performance and robustness
tldr: This paper proposes τ, a touch-augmented VLA framework that learns action-conditioned spatiotemporal tactile representations from future visual supervision using a JEPA-like approach, and introduces TacAura, a dataset of synchronized vision, proprioception, and tactile signals for contact-rich manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 τ，一种触觉增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过类似 JEPA 的方式从未来视觉监督中学习动作条件的时空触觉表示，并引入了 TacAura 数据集，该数据集包含接触丰富操作任务中同步的视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在数据和建模两个层面上，学习富有信息的触觉表征并将其有效适配到预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中仍具有挑战性。在数据层面，有限的任务特定演示限制了表征质量，而大规模预训练则带来高昂成本。在建模层面，现有方法要么聚焦于瞬时接触状态，要么利用六维力矩序列建模时间交互动态，高维触觉信号尚未得到充分探索。为解决这些问题，我们提出τ——一种触觉增强的VLA框架，该框架受联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）启发，从未来视觉监督中学习动作条件化的时空触觉表征，并将其与视觉-语言特征融合，在有限数据条件下生成动作。该监督在潜在空间中运行且仅用于训练阶段，不会增加部署开销。我们还引入了TacAura数据集，该数据集包含四种典型密集接触操作任务中的同步视觉、本体感知及基于视觉的触觉信号。实验表明，τ优于现有模型，并能泛化至未见过的物体与场景，展现出更优的操作性能与鲁棒性。

title: PAC-DP: PAC-Bayesian Diffusion Policy Learning
summary: Diffusion Policies (DPs) are able to perform complex manipulation tasks. However, DPs are typically trained by minimizing a denoising objective, which provides limited control over generalization in the finite-data regimes common in robotics. In this letter, we propose PAC-DP, an approach that increases the performance of DPs in robotic manipulation tasks. By modeling the DP as a Bayesian neural network, and defining a PAC-Bayes generalization bound, we derive a novel training objective that augments the standard denoising loss with a Kullback-Leibler divergence regularizer between the posterior and prior parameter distributions. From the theoretical perspective, our approach provides a principled approach to regularize the training of DPs without significantly increasing the training time. From the practical point of view, experimental results demonstrate improved denoising performance, lower variational negative log-likelihood, and higher success rates across multiple robotic manipulation benchmarks. Crucially, the largest improvements are observed in low-data training regimes and complex tasks, establishing PAC-DP as a theoretically grounded framework for robot policy learning.
tldr: PAC-DP augments diffusion policy training with a PAC-Bayesian regularizer to improve generalization and success rates in robotic manipulation, especially with limited data.
tldr_zh: PAC-DP 通过 PAC-Bayesian 正则化增强扩散策略训练，提高了机器人操作任务中的泛化能力和成功率，尤其在数据有限时效果显著。
summary_zh: 扩散策略（DPs）能够执行复杂的操作任务。然而，DPs通常通过最小化去噪目标进行训练，这在机器人学常见的有穷数据场景中对泛化能力的控制有限。本文提出PAC-DP方法，旨在提升DPs在机器人操作任务中的性能。通过将DP建模为贝叶斯神经网络，并定义PAC-贝叶斯泛化界，我们推导出一种新型训练目标——在标准去噪损失函数中引入后验与先验参数分布间的库尔贝克-莱布勒散度正则化项。理论层面，本方法为规范DP训练提供了原则性框架，且未显著增加训练时间；实践层面，实验结果表明该方法在多个机器人操作基准中实现了去噪性能提升、变分负对数似然降低及成功率提高。关键的是，在低数据训练场景与复杂任务中改进最为显著，使PAC-DP成为机器人策略学习中具有理论依据的框架。

title: FeelWorld: Visuo-Tactile World Model for Hierarchical Contact Prediction and Planning
summary: Humans plan physical interactions by imagining the possible outcomes of candidate actions. However, existing visual world models primarily capture appearance dynamics while overlooking the tactile states that govern contact-rich interactions, potentially producing imagined futures that appear visually plausible but violate physical dynamics. We introduce FeelWorld, a hierarchical visuo-tactile world model that jointly predicts future visual latents and three tactile states. FeelWorld organizes these states hierarchically as contact state, a 3D tactile latent that encodes force-related information, and slip state. These states are jointly predicted by a shared latent dynamics model with explicit supervision. To prevent irrelevant tactile signals during free-space motion from degrading visual prediction, we introduce a contact-gated asymmetric attention mechanism that maintains a visual-only prediction pathway before contact and enables joint visuo-tactile dynamics prediction during contact. The model is further trained with autoregressive rollouts and context noise injection to improve robustness to compounding errors. The predicted contact and slip states also support contact-aware CEM planning. Experiments on chip grasping, fruit grasping, and USB insertion show that FeelWorld reduces 10-step LPIPS from 0.084 to 0.058 and maintains an LPIPS that is 61% lower than that of the visual baseline after an 80-step autoregressive rollout. FeelWorld also achieves an average zero-shot planning success rate of 81.7%, providing an effective approach for incorporating tactile sensing into world models.
tldr: FeelWorld is a hierarchical visuo-tactile world model that jointly predicts visual latents and tactile states (contact, force, slip) with a contact-gated attention mechanism, improving long-horizon visual prediction and enabling contact-aware planning for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: FeelWorld 是一种分层视觉-触觉世界模型，通过接触门控注意力机制联合预测视觉潜变量和触觉状态（接触、力、滑移），提升了长程视觉预测的准确性，并支持接触感知的机器人操作规划。
summary_zh: 人类通过想象候选动作的可能结果来规划物理交互。然而，现有的视觉世界模型主要捕捉外观动态，却忽视了支配接触丰富交互的触觉状态，这可能导致生成的未来场景在视觉上看似合理，但违背了物理动力学规律。我们提出FeelWorld——一种分层式的视觉-触觉世界模型，能够联合预测未来视觉潜在表征与三种触觉状态。FeelWorld将这些状态分层组织为接触状态、编码力相关信息的3D触觉潜在表征以及滑动状态，并通过共享的潜在动力学模型与显式监督机制实现这些状态的联合预测。为避免自由空间运动过程中的无关触觉信号降低视觉预测质量，我们引入接触门控非对称注意力机制：在接触发生前维持纯视觉预测通路，接触发生时启用视觉-触觉联合动力学预测。该模型进一步通过自回归展开与上下文噪声注入进行训练，以增强对累积误差的鲁棒性。预测的接触状态与滑动状态还可支撑接触感知的CEM规划。在芯片抓取、水果抓取及USB插拔实验中的结果表明，FeelWorld将10步LPIPS从0.084降至0.058，并在80步自回归展开后保持比纯视觉基线低61%的LPIPS。此外，FeelWorld实现了平均81.7%的零样本规划成功率，为将触觉感知融入世界模型提供了有效方法。

title: Learning Reusable Hybrid Motion Priors for Humanoid Locomotion from Motion Imitation
summary: Reinforcement learning can produce robust humanoid controllers, but each new task is typically trained as a separate policy with its own reward design and training process. Motion imitation provides an alternative source of motor competence by training policies to track retargeted human motions, yet the resulting controllers remain reference trackers and are not directly usable as task policies. We propose a three-stage pipeline that turns motion-imitation skills into a reusable hybrid motion prior (HMP) for humanoid locomotion. First, an expert policy is trained to imitate retargeted human motion-capture clips. Second, the expert is distilled into a frozen architecture composed of a proprioceptive encoder, a residual vector-quantized (RVQ) codebook, and an action decoder. Third, task-level policies are trained to solve locomotion tasks by selecting discrete codebook entries while the HMP remains frozen. We evaluate the method on velocity tracking, point-goal navigation, and fall-recovery velocity tracking in simulation, and deploy the velocity-tracking policy on a real Unitree G1 robot. The distillation process preserves the tracking behavior of the expert, while the resulting HMP can be reused without retraining as the action interface for different downstream locomotion policies. The learned HMP reveals an interpretable codebook structure in which the number of active RVQ stages modulates the available gait patterns. We further show that training the codebook with the rotation trick improves latent organization and reduces downstream falls compared with a standard straight-through estimator.
tldr: This paper introduces a three-stage pipeline that distills motion-imitation skills into a reusable hybrid motion prior (HMP) for humanoid locomotion, enabling downstream task policies to control locomotion by selecting discrete codebook entries from a frozen HMP.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种三阶段流水线，将运动模仿技能蒸馏为可复用的混合运动先验（HMP），使下游任务策略能通过选择离散码本条目来控制人形机器人运动。
summary_zh: 强化学习能够生成稳健的人形控制器，但每个新任务通常需作为独立策略进行训练，并配以单独的奖励设计与训练流程。运动模仿通过训练策略跟踪重定向的人类运动，提供了另一种运动技能来源，但所生成的控制器仍属于参考轨迹跟踪器，无法直接作为任务策略使用。我们提出一种三阶段流水线，将运动模仿技能转化为可复用的混合运动先验（HMP），用于人形机器人 locomotion。首先，训练一个专家策略以模仿重定向的人体运动捕捉片段。其次，将专家策略蒸馏至一个由本体感知编码器、残差向量量化（RVQ）码本及动作解码器构成的冻结架构中。最后，在保持HMP冻结的条件下，通过选择离散码本条目训练任务级策略以解决 locomotion 任务。我们在仿真中评估了该方法在速度跟踪、点目标导航及跌倒恢复速度跟踪上的表现，并在真实宇树G1机器人上部署了速度跟踪策略。蒸馏过程保留了专家策略的跟踪行为，而生成的HMP可作为不同下游运动策略的动作接口直接复用，无需重新训练。所学习的HMP展现出可解释的码本结构，其中激活的RVQ阶段数量可调节可用步态模式。我们进一步证明，与标准直通估计器相比，采用旋转技巧训练码本可改善潜在空间组织并减少下游跌倒次数。

title: LeapBot-WA: World-Anchor Action Models via Predictive Latent Alignments
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied intelligence, yet the prevailing reliance on pixel-level video generation creates a fundamental bottleneck. Forcing models to reconstruct task-irrelevant visual details dissipates representational capacity and renders policies vulnerable to visual distractors. In this paper, we propose LeapBot-WA, which establishes a novel Predictive-Latent paradigm for WAMs by operationalizing the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) as a World-Anchor. Departing from the traditional reliance on visual synthesis, LeapBot-WA shifts the core of world modeling to Predictive Semantic Alignment, extracting abstract physical dynamics directly within a latent foundation space. To bridge the modality gap between non-Gaussian predictive features and diffusion priors, we introduce the Isotropic Semantic Autoencoder (ISAE), which reshapes the anchor's latent space into a diffusion-friendly manifold to prevent off-manifold drift. Furthermore, we design an Asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. During training, an Anchor Diffusion Transformer acts as a privileged dynamics expert to guide the Action Diffusion Transformer; at inference, this heavy dynamics branch is pruned, enabling zero-overhead execution. LeapBot-WA achieves state-of-the-art performance among predictive models on LIBERO and matches top-tier generative WAMs on RoboTwin 2.0 without requiring large-scale trajectory pre-training. It further demonstrates superior zero-shot robustness to unseen environments and successful real-world transfer, establishing a highly efficient and robust latent-centric paradigm for scalable robotic control. Code: https://github.com/LeapWM/leapbot-wa.
tldr: LeapBot-WA proposes a predictive-latent World Action Model using JEPA and an Isotropic Semantic Autoencoder to avoid pixel-level video generation, achieving efficient and robust robotic control.
tldr_zh: LeapBot-WA 提出了一种基于预测潜变量的世界动作模型，利用 JEPA 和各向同性语义自编码器避免像素级视频生成，实现了高效且鲁棒的机器人控制。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为具身智能领域的一种强大范式，然而当前对像素级视频生成的普遍依赖造成了根本性瓶颈。迫使模型重建与任务无关的视觉细节会消耗表征能力，并使策略易受视觉干扰物的影响。本文提出LeapBot-WA，通过将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）运作化为世界锚点，为WAMs建立了一种新颖的预测-潜在范式。LeapBot-WA摒弃了传统对视觉合成的依赖，将世界模型的核心转向预测语义对齐，直接在潜在基础空间中提取抽象的物理动态。为弥合非高斯预测特征与扩散先验之间的模态鸿沟，我们引入了各向同性语义自编码器（ISAE），该编码器将锚点潜在空间重塑为扩散友好流形，以防止离流形漂移。此外，我们设计了非对称混合变换器（MoT）架构：在训练阶段，锚点扩散变换器作为特权动力学专家指导动作扩散变换器；在推理阶段，该重动力学分支被剪除，从而实现零开销执行。LeapBot-WA在LIBERO基准上达到了预测模型的最佳性能，并在无需大规模轨迹预训练的情况下，与RoboTwin 2.0上的顶级生成式WAMs性能持平。它进一步展现了在未知环境中卓越的零样本鲁棒性以及成功的真实世界迁移能力，为可扩展的机器人控制建立了一种高效且鲁棒的以潜在为中心的范式。代码：https://github.com/LeapWM/leapbot-wa。

title: SimBEV2X: A Large-Scale Dataset and Data Generation Tool for Multi-Task Vehicle-to-Everything Cooperative Perception
summary: Cooperative perception through vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication can overcome the inherent physical limitations of individual autonomous vehicles, such as occlusions and limited sensor range. However, the development of robust V2X algorithms, particularly those relying on unified spatial representations like bird's-eye view (BEV) representation, is hampered by the lack of large-scale, multi-modal, multi-task datasets. Moreover, collecting and annotating a large set of synchronized, real-world multi-agent data is prohibitively expensive. This has resulted in a landscape where existing V2X datasets are notably limited in both size and scope. To overcome this, we introduce SimBEV2X, an advanced synthetic data generation tool built on the CARLA simulator. SimBEV2X automatically creates randomized driving scenarios to collect multi-modal sensor data alongside various types of ground truth including 3D bounding boxes with unique track IDs, HD map information, BEV segmentation maps, and semantic occupancy voxel grids from both vehicles and RSUs. We also present the SimBEV2X dataset, the largest V2X perception dataset to date. The dataset comprises 258 scenes, each involving up to 8 connected vehicles and up to 4 RSUs across a variety of road networks. The SimBEV2X dataset is an order of magnitude larger than existing V2X datasets and contains 102,200 frames, 588,520 lidar point clouds, more than 3 million images, over 27 million bounding boxes, and a comprehensive set of other annotations. Finally, we establish a strong baseline on the SimBEV2X dataset using CoopDet3D and propose CoBEVFusion, a novel architecture that combines CoopDet3D with fused axial attention (FAX) for context-aware multi-agent feature aggregation, resulting in superior performance. SimBEV2X, the SimBEV2X dataset, and CoBEVFusion are available at https://simbev2x.org and https://github.com/GoodarzMehr/SimBEV2X.
tldr: This paper introduces SimBEV2X, a synthetic data generation tool and large-scale dataset for multi-task V2X cooperative perception in autonomous driving, and proposes CoBEVFusion, a novel architecture for context-aware multi-agent feature aggregation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SimBEV2X，一个用于自动驾驶中多任务V2X协同感知的大规模合成数据生成工具和数据集，并提出了CoBEVFusion，一种用于上下文感知多智能体特征聚合的新型架构。
summary_zh: 通过车联网（V2X）通信实现的协同感知能够克服单车自动驾驶固有的物理限制，如遮挡和有限的传感器探测范围。然而，鲁棒的V2X算法（特别是依赖鸟瞰图（BEV）这种统一空间表征的算法）的开发，因缺乏大规模、多模态、多任务数据集而受到阻碍。此外，采集和标注大量同步的真实世界多智能体数据成本极高，导致现有V2X数据集在规模和范围上均十分有限。为突破这一瓶颈，我们提出了基于CARLA仿真器构建的先进合成数据生成工具SimBEV2X。该工具可自动生成随机驾驶场景，以采集多模态传感器数据及多种真值信息，包括带唯一跟踪ID的三维边界框、高精地图信息、BEV分割图以及来自车辆和路侧单元（RSU）的语义占据体素网格。同时，我们发布了SimBEV2X数据集——迄今为止最大的V2X感知数据集。该数据集包含258个场景，每个场景涉及多达8辆网联车辆和4个RSU，覆盖多种道路网络。SimBEV2X数据集的规模比现有V2X数据集大一个数量级，包含102,200帧数据、588,520个激光雷达点云、超过300万张图像、2700万个边界框以及丰富的其他标注信息。最后，我们利用CoopDet3D在SimBEV2X数据集上建立了强有力基线，并提出了CoBEVFusion这一新型架构，它将CoopDet3D与融合轴向注意力（FAX）相结合，实现了上下文感知的多智能体特征聚合，性能表现卓越。SimBEV2X工具、SimBEV2X数据集及CoBEVFusion架构均可访问https://simbev2x.org 和 https://github.com/GoodarzMehr/SimBEV2X 获取。

title: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling
summary: Many recent robot policies pursue stronger control by using large pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) as the action backbone. We introduce WorldDiT, a unified diffusion transformer architecture that couples action generation with visual world modeling and achieves strong performance without a large pretrained VLM action backbone. During training, a single diffusion transformer generates continuous action chunks and predicts normalized RGB patch targets from future camera frames. Across four LIBERO simulation suites, WorldDiT lies on the reported Pareto frontier for total model parameters and mean success among methods reporting all four suites. These results provide a strong sub-billion-parameter baseline for future scaling studies.
tldr: WorldDiT proposes a unified diffusion transformer architecture that jointly generates action chunks and predicts future visual patches, achieving strong robot manipulation results without a large pretrained VLM backbone.
tldr_zh: WorldDiT 提出了一种统一的扩散变换器架构，联合生成动作块和预测未来视觉块，在无需大规模预训练 VLM 骨干的情况下实现了强大的机器人操作性能。
summary_zh: 许多近期机器人策略通过采用大型预训练的视觉语言模型作为动作主干网络，以实现更强的控制能力。我们提出WorldDiT——一种统一的扩散Transformer架构，该架构将动作生成与视觉世界建模相结合，无需大型预训练视觉语言模型作为动作主干即可实现卓越性能。在训练阶段，单个扩散Transformer生成连续动作片段，并从未来相机帧中预测归一化的RGB图像块目标。在四个LIBERO仿真套件中，WorldDiT在所有报告四个套件方法的总模型参数与平均成功率中处于已知帕累托前沿。这些结果为未来规模扩展研究提供了低于十亿参数的强基线基准。

title: Embodied GPT-5.1: Evidence of a World Model?
summary: This exploratory study examines whether a large multimodal language model, GPT-5.1, can serve as the high-level controller of a physical mobile robot despite having no prior embodiment, no training in simulated environments, and no exposure to sensorimotor experience. Using only low-resolution first-person images and a discrete action set, the model was tasked with navigation and object-directed behaviors such as locating and contacting a target toy. Across multiple trials, GPT-5.1 demonstrated emergent capabilities that suggest elements of spatial reasoning and physical understanding. These included maintaining short-term memory of object locations after they left the camera frame, inferring the physical consequences of its own movements, and executing coherent action sequences such as colliding with an object and reversing to visually verify the outcome. At the same time, the model displayed inefficiencies and perceptual limitations, including imprecise alignment strategies and occasional misidentification of distant distractors. Overall, the results indicate that GPT-5.1 exhibits signs of world-model-like behavior in an embodied setting, despite the absence of any embodiment-related training, a finding that challenges long-standing views in cognitive science and robotics which hold that a physical body is a necessary prerequisite for developing such forms of intelligence. The findings motivate deeper investigation into the emergence, limits, and robustness of physical understanding in large language models.
tldr: This paper tests GPT-5.1 as a high-level controller for a physical mobile robot using only first-person images and discrete actions, finding emergent spatial reasoning and world-model-like behavior despite no embodied training.
tldr_zh: 本文测试了 GPT-5.1 仅使用第一人称图像和离散动作作为物理移动机器人高层控制器，发现其在没有具身训练的情况下涌现出空间推理和类似世界模型的行为。
summary_zh: 本探索性研究考察了大型多模态语言模型GPT-5.1是否能在无先验具身经验、无模拟环境训练、且无传感器运动体验的条件下，充当实体移动机器人的高层控制器。该模型仅依靠低分辨率第一人称图像及离散动作集，需完成导航及目标导向行为（例如定位并接触目标玩具）。在多次试验中，GPT-5.1展现出涌现能力，表明其具备空间推理与物理理解要素：包括在物体离开摄像头视野后保持对物体位置的短期记忆、推断自身运动的物理后果，以及执行连贯动作序列（如撞击物体后倒车以视觉验证结果）。同时，该模型也表现出低效性与感知局限，例如不精确的对准策略及偶尔误识别远处干扰物。总体而言，结果表明GPT-5.1在具身场景中展现出类似世界模型的行为迹象，尽管其未接受任何具身相关训练——这一发现挑战了认知科学与机器人学中长期存在的观点，即物理身体是发展此类智能形式的必要前提。该发现促使进一步探究大语言模型中物理理解的涌现机制、边界及鲁棒性。

title: A Few Words Go a Long Way: Language Guided Robot Policy Synthesis
summary: While vision-language-action models have demonstrated impressive zero-shot manipulation capabilities, they remain fundamentally black box policies that are difficult to interpret, adapt, or correct when they inevitably fail. In this work, we propose ARCHITECT, a framework that treats robot policy acquisition as an interactive program synthesis task. ARCHITECT leverages the reasoning capabilities of LLM coding agents to synthesize modular robot programs that utilize a suite of perception and control tools. Unlike end-to-end models where distribution shift leads to unpredictable, cascading failures, our modular architecture allows users to isolate failures and localize feedback at the level of abstraction required. We introduce an iterative process where a human supervisor provides natural language corrections to steer the policy. These corrections are grounded in the policy code by program execution traces and distilled into a persistent skill library, a form of long-term in-context learning which enables the agent to accumulate a repertoire of reusable, interpretable behaviors. In a benchmark evaluation on a Franka Panda robot, ARCHITECT outperforms state-of-the-art VLA models and program synthesis baselines on complex, long-horizon tasks, including articulated object manipulation and cloth folding. Our results demonstrate that the synthesized skill library enables the system to transfer to novel tasks with decreasing human intervention, providing a steerable and data-efficient alternative to black-box robot learning. Website: https://robo-architect.github.io/
tldr: A framework that uses LLM coding agents to synthesize modular robot programs from natural language corrections, outperforming black-box VLA models on long-horizon tasks and enabling transfer via a reusable skill library.
tldr_zh: 提出一种利用LLM编程代理从自然语言纠正中合成模块化机器人程序的框架，在长时域任务上超越黑箱VLA模型，并通过可复用的技能库实现任务迁移。
summary_zh: 尽管视觉-语言-动作模型已展现出令人瞩目的零样本操作能力，但其本质上仍属黑箱策略，在不可避免出现故障时难以解释、调整或修正。本研究提出ARCHITECT框架，将机器人策略获取视为交互式程序合成任务。该框架利用大语言模型编码代理的推理能力，通过一组感知与控制工具合成模块化机器人程序。与分布偏移会导致不可预测级联故障的端到端模型不同，我们的模块化架构允许用户在所需抽象层级隔离故障并定位反馈。我们引入迭代流程，由人类监督员提供自然语言修正以引导策略。这些修正通过程序执行轨迹锚定在策略代码中，并提炼为持久技能库——这是一种长期上下文学习形式，使代理能够积累可复用、可解释的行为集。在Franka Panda机器人的基准评估中，ARCHITECT在包括铰接物体操作与布料折叠在内的复杂长时域任务上，优于最先进的VLA模型及程序合成基线。实验结果表明，合成的技能库使系统能在人类干预递减的情况下迁移至新任务，为黑箱机器人学习提供了可引导且数据高效的替代方案。网站：https://robo-architect.github.io/

title: Denial of Deadline: Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse in Distributed Inference Pipelines
summary:
Inference systems increasingly combine a fast path that returns predictions within the application's latency deadline together with a higher-accuracy slow path that runs higher-compute methods on stronger, remote hardware, so its results can be returned on time and combined with the fast path predictions. Across several application domains, we abstract this inference architecture as a fast path, a slow path, and a coordination layer with two functions: a router that invokes the slow path and a merger that decides whether to incorporate its returned predictions. In this work, we show that this new coordination layer exposes a new attack surface: shaped workload attacks, e.g., Yo-Yo bursts, can exploit contention at shared resources along the slow path to push benign users' slow-path predictions past their latency deadlines. The merger then discards those predictions, while the fast path continues to return timely outputs. We refer to the resulting loss of slow-path accuracy benefits as accuracy collapse.
  We demonstrate accuracy collapse in a two-tier edge-cloud multi-object tracking pipeline in autonomous driving. In simulation, approximately 4,000 burst-shaped requests increase benign p99 latency from 92ms to 2s, nearly eliminating the benefit of the slow path's cloud inference, reducing object tracking quality by 7.0 HOTA points on average. We further find that accuracy degradation can significantly vary (2.0-18.7 HOTA points), depending on the video intervals that are targeted in the attack, and that certain rare classes (e.g., stop signs) lose nearly half of their pre-attack prediction accuracy. These results show that workload attacks can degrade prediction quality without needing either access to model weights or victim data, and motivate research on attacks and defenses for routing, merging, scheduling, and resource isolation in these emerging inference pipeline architectures.
tldr: This paper identifies a new attack surface in distributed inference pipelines that combine a fast local path with a higher-accuracy remote slow path, and demonstrates that workload attacks can cause accuracy collapse in an autonomous driving multi-object tracking system by delaying slow-path predictions beyond their latency deadlines.
tldr_zh: 本文揭示了结合快速本地路径与高精度远程慢速路径的分布式推理管道中存在的新的攻击面，并通过自动驾驶多目标跟踪系统证明工作负载攻击可导致慢速路径预测延迟超过其延迟截止期限，从而引发精度崩溃。
summary_zh:
推理系统越来越多地采用一种架构：快速路径在应用延迟截止时间内返回预测结果，而高精度慢速路径在更强大的远程硬件上运行更高计算量的方法，以便其结果能及时返回并与快速路径预测相结合。在多个应用领域中，我们将这种推理架构抽象为快速路径、慢速路径以及一个协调层——该协调层包含两个功能：调用慢速路径的路由器，以及决定是否采纳其返回预测结果的合并器。本研究表明，这一新型协调层暴露了一个新的攻击面：塑形工作负载攻击（如Yo-Yo突发流量）可利用慢速路径共享资源的争用，迫使良性用户的慢速路径预测错过延迟截止时间。合并器随后丢弃这些预测结果，而快速路径仍继续返回及时的输出。我们将由此导致的慢速路径准确性增益损失称为“准确性崩溃”。

我们在自动驾驶的两级边缘-云多目标跟踪流水线中演示了准确性崩溃。仿真中，约4000个突发塑形请求将良性用户的p99延迟从92毫秒增加至2秒，几乎消除了慢速路径云端推理的增益，平均降低目标跟踪质量7.0个HOTA点。我们进一步发现，准确性下降幅度存在显著差异（2.0-18.7个HOTA点），具体取决于攻击针对的视频时段，某些稀有类别（如停车标志）的预测准确性甚至损失近半。这些结果表明，工作负载攻击无需访问模型权重或受害者数据即可降低预测质量，从而推动了针对此类新兴推理流水线架构中路由、合并、调度及资源隔离的攻击与防御研究。

title: A Motion-Aware Vector Quantization Framework with Centroid Reuse for Efficient VLA Inference
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong potential for embodied AI, yet their high inference latency on GPUs limits real-time deployment. Existing accelerators, such as Dadu-Corki, improve efficiency but treat VLA models as full-precision workloads, leaving substantial redundancy in both memory and computation underexploited.
  In this paper, we propose VQVLA, an algorithm-hardware co-design framework that accelerates VLA inference by exploiting weight similarity and execution dynamics. We first introduce MotionVQ, a motion-aware vector quantization scheme that dynamically adjusts quantization precision based on the robot's execution state, reducing memory access while preserving task success rate. We then propose a merged-centroid vectorized GEMM paradigm that operates on the codebook-index representation, eliminating redundant multiplications through spatial aggregation and temporal reuse of centroids. To realize these optimizations, we design an accelerator that efficiently supports dynamic precision selection and centroid-reuse computation. Experimental results show that VQVLA achieves 6.5x, 2.8x, 1.9x, 3.3x, and 4.3x speedup over the A100 GPU, Dadu-Corki, LUT-DLA, CodeGEMM, and ShiftAddLLM, respectively, with negligible accuracy degradation.
tldr: Proposes VQVLA, an algorithm-hardware co-design framework that accelerates VLA inference via motion-aware vector quantization and centroid-reuse GEMM, achieving significant speedups on GPU and specialized accelerators.
tldr_zh: 提出 VQVLA，一种算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过运动感知矢量量化和质心重用 GEMM 加速 VLA 推理，在 GPU 和专用加速器上实现显著加速。
summary_zh:
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身智能领域展现出巨大潜力，但其在GPU上的高推理延迟限制了实时部署。现有加速器（如Dadu-Corki）虽提升了效率，却将VLA模型视为全精度负载，导致内存与计算中大量冗余未被充分挖掘。

本文提出VQVLA，一种利用权重相似性与执行动态性加速VLA推理的算法-硬件协同设计框架。我们首先引入MotionVQ——一种运动感知向量量化方案，可根据机器人执行状态动态调整量化精度，在保持任务成功率的同时减少内存访问。继而提出基于码本索引表示的质心合并向量化GEMM范式，通过质心的空间聚合与时间复用消除冗余乘法。为实现上述优化，我们设计了一款支持动态精度选择与质心复用计算的加速器。实验结果表明，VQVLA相较于A100 GPU、Dadu-Corki、LUT-DLA、CodeGEMM及ShiftAddLLM分别实现6.5倍、2.8倍、1.9倍、3.3倍和4.3倍加速比，且精度损失可忽略不计。

title: MATS: A novel multi-modality multi-task learning framework for 3D perception in autonomous driving
summary: Multi-modality data from different sensors provides rich complementary information for 3D perception, becoming an essential component in reliable autonomous driving systems. Current research typically designs intricate and complex fusion strategies to integrate information from multimodal data on a unified bird's-eye-view (BEV) feature map for the joint learning of multiple perception tasks. However, such a single feature map hardly carries sufficient information to simultaneously meet the requirements of various perception tasks, leading to a very limited perception performance. To mitigate this limitation, this paper proposes MATS, a novel multi-modality multi-task learning approach with modality-adaptive BEV fusion and task-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) for 3D perception. Specifically, a simple modality-adaptive BEV fusion module is designed to adaptively recalibrate the BEV features by modeling the global cross-modality dependencies, generating diverse BEV feature maps for various perception tasks. For joint multi-task learning, this paper proposes a task-specific MoE module to decouple the tasks and enable the network to automatically choose the appropriate BEV feature candidates for each specific task. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, we conduct extensive experiments on the large-scale benchmark nuScenes. With the camera- and LiDAR-modality input data, the proposed approach outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by a significant margin. Furthermore, the experimental results on the single tasks show that the proposed approach significantly outperforms the baselines. The code and trained models will be available upon publication.
tldr: This paper proposes MATS, a multi-modality multi-task learning framework for 3D perception in autonomous driving, featuring modality-adaptive BEV fusion and task-specific Mixture-of-Experts to improve perception performance beyond existing fusion strategies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MATS，一种用于自动驾驶3D感知的多模态多任务学习框架，通过模态自适应BEV融合和任务特定专家混合机制提升感知性能。
summary_zh: 来自不同传感器的多模态数据为三维感知提供了丰富的互补信息，已成为可靠自动驾驶系统中的关键组成部分。当前研究通常设计复杂精细的融合策略，将多模态数据信息集成到统一的鸟瞰视角（BEV）特征图上，以实现多感知任务的联合学习。然而，单一特征图难以承载足够信息同时满足不同感知任务的需求，导致感知性能极为有限。为解决这一局限，本文提出MATS——一种面向三维感知的新型多模态多任务学习方法，该方法采用模态自适应BEV融合与任务特定混合专家（MoE）机制。具体而言，我们设计了一个简单的模态自适应BEV融合模块，通过建模全局跨模态依赖关系自适应地重新校准BEV特征，从而为不同感知任务生成多样化的BEV特征图。针对联合多任务学习，本文提出任务特定MoE模块以解耦任务，使网络能够自动为每个特定任务选择最合适的BEV特征候选。为验证所提方法的有效性，我们在大规模基准数据集nuScenes上开展了广泛实验。在相机与激光雷达模态输入数据条件下，所提方法显著超越当前最先进（SOTA）水平。此外，单任务实验结果表明，本方法相较基线方法具有显著优势。代码与预训练模型将在论文发表后公开。

title: Reasoning to Regulate: Chain-of-Thought for Traffic Rule Understanding
summary: Understanding and complying with traffic regulations is a safety-critical requirement for autonomous driving, yet remains challenging due to the diversity and context dependence of traffic signage. Importantly, regulation understanding is not a simple recognition task, but a reasoning problem: whether a rule applies depends on interpreting the sign in relation to the spatial layout of lanes and scene context. To support such reasoning, MapDR provide fine-grained annotations that link each traffic sign's regulatory rules to the specific lanes they govern. Existing methods, however, largely treat this as direct sequence prediction, ignoring the underlying reasoning that connects sign semantics and map structure. To address this limitation, we explicitly incorporate reasoning into this task and propose a framework that equips vision-language models (VLMs) with chain-of-thought (CoT) capabilities. We first design a scalable CoT curation pipeline that bootstraps rationales from a strong LLM through a two-round strategy and employs a VLM-based verifier to filter out incorrect cases, yielding a high-quality set of (CoT, answer) pairs. Building on this foundation, we adopt a two-stage training scheme: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to teach rationale-to-answer generation, followed by GRPO reinforcement learning with answer-grounded, fine-grained rewards to further improve final answer accuracy. Extensive experiments on MapDR show that our approach significantly improves both interpretability and accuracy, establishing the first reasoning-based framework for regulation-aware autonomous driving.
tldr: This paper proposes a chain-of-thought reasoning framework for traffic rule understanding in autonomous driving, using a scalable CoT curation pipeline and two-stage training (SFT + GRPO) to improve interpretability and accuracy on the MapDR benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于自动驾驶交通规则理解的链式思维推理框架，通过可扩展的CoT生成管道和两阶段训练（SFT + GRPO），在MapDR基准上提升了可解释性和准确性。
summary_zh: 理解并遵守交通法规是自动驾驶中关乎安全的关键要求，但由于交通标志的多样性和上下文依赖性，这一任务仍具有挑战性。重要的是，法规理解并非简单的识别任务，而是一个推理问题：规则是否适用，取决于对标志与车道空间布局及场景上下文之间关系的解读。为支持此类推理，MapDR提供了细粒度标注，将每个交通标志的管制规则与其管辖的具体车道相关联。然而，现有方法大多将其视为直接的序列预测，忽略了连接标志语义与地图结构的潜在推理过程。为解决这一局限，我们明确将推理引入该任务，并提出一个框架，赋予视觉语言模型（VLM）思维链（CoT）能力。我们首先设计了一个可扩展的CoT整理流程，通过两轮策略从强大的大语言模型中引导出推理依据，并采用基于VLM的验证器过滤错误案例，从而获得高质量的（CoT，答案）配对。在此基础上，我们采用两阶段训练方案：先通过监督微调（SFT）学习从推理依据到答案的生成，再采用基于答案的细粒度奖励进行GRPO强化学习，以进一步提升最终答案的准确性。在MapDR上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了可解释性与准确性，为法规感知自动驾驶建立了首个基于推理的框架。

title: NEO: NeRF It Once, Edit It Many Times for Continuous Object Manipulation
summary: In this paper, we present NEO, a unified framework providing language-guided NeRF editing for robotic manipulation. Our paper introduces (i) a language-guided object removal that combines neural field resampling with multiview-consistent progressive inpainting, (ii) a direct NeRF weight editing method utilizing knowledge distillation, composing original and edited NeRFs via a teacher-student model, enabling coherent modeling of future scene states before a robot executes an action, and (iii) the first benchmark (NEO-Dataset) for quantitatively evaluating NeRF scene editing methods suitable for robot manipulation. We show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in scene editing tasks, including object removal and pick-and-place robotic experiments, yielding visually coherent and geometrically consistent edits that reduce artifacts commonly introduced by prior methods.
tldr: NEO introduces a language-guided NeRF editing framework for robotic manipulation, enabling object removal and pick-and-place with consistent scene updates before action execution.
tldr_zh: NEO提出了一个语言引导的NeRF编辑框架用于机器人操作，支持物体移除和抓取放置操作，在动作执行前生成一致的场景更新。
summary_zh: 本文提出NEO——一个为机器人操作提供语言引导的NeRF编辑的统一框架。我们引入：(i) 一种结合神经场重采样与多视图一致性渐进修复的语言引导物体移除方法；(ii) 一种利用知识蒸馏的NeRF权重直接编辑方法，通过教师-学生模型组合原始NeRF与编辑后NeRF，使机器人在执行动作前能够对未来的场景状态进行连贯建模；(iii) 首个用于定量评估适用于机器人操作的NeRF场景编辑方法的基准数据集（NEO-Dataset）。实验表明，本方法在物体移除、拾取与放置等机器人操作的场景编辑任务中优于现有基线方法，能够生成视觉连贯且几何一致的编辑结果，显著减少先前方法常引入的伪影。

title: KAI: A Kinematic-Aware Interface for Data-Efficient Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: Articulated object manipulation requires an understanding of kinematic structure that is difficult and costly to learn from robot demonstrations alone. We introduce the Kinematic-Aware Articulation Interface (KAI), a structured intermediate representation that captures the kinematic structure of articulated objects. By embedding interpretable geometric and kinematic priors into policy learning, KAI provides a strong inductive bias aligned with the underlying structure of articulated motion. This design effectively improves sample efficiency, with gains particularly pronounced in low-data regimes: across six simulation tasks, our method achieves an average success rate of 82.9%, matching or surpassing baseline performance while using only half the demonstration data. Our method also exhibits robust generalization to unseen backgrounds and visual distractors, transferring from a single clean training environment to cluttered real-world scenes. KAI's action-agnostic design further enables co-training with human interaction videos to enhance real-world robustness: under diverse visual distractions, our method with video co-training achieves over 70% average success rate.
tldr: KAI introduces a kinematic-aware representation for articulated object manipulation that improves sample efficiency and robustness, matching baseline performance with half the data and generalizing to cluttered real-world scenes.
tldr_zh: KAI提出了一种运动学感知表示用于铰接物体操作，提高了样本效率和鲁棒性，使用一半数据即可达到基线性能，并泛化到杂乱真实场景。
summary_zh: 铰接物体操作需要理解运动学结构，而仅通过机器人示教学习这种结构既困难又成本高昂。我们提出了运动学感知铰接接口（KAI），这是一种结构化的中间表征，能够捕捉铰接物体的运动学结构。通过将可解释的几何与运动学先验嵌入策略学习过程，KAI为与铰接运动底层结构一致的强归纳偏置提供了支持。该设计有效提升了样本效率，在低数据场景下效果尤为显著：在六项仿真任务中，我们的方法仅使用半数示教数据即达到82.9%的平均成功率，与基线性能持平甚至更优。该方法还展现出对未见背景与视觉干扰物的稳健泛化能力，能够从单一清洁训练环境迁移至杂乱的真实场景。KAI的动作无关设计进一步支持通过人类交互视频进行协同训练以增强真实世界鲁棒性：在多种视觉干扰下，采用视频协同训练的方法实现了超过70%的平均成功率。

title: ArmnetBench v0.1: Parallel Real-World Evaluation of Manipulation Policies on a Low-Cost Arm Farm
summary: Real-world evaluation is a bottleneck in developing generalist robot manipulation policies. Each rollout requires physical hardware and an operator to set up, reset, and score it. We introduce ArmnetBench v0.1, a benchmark run on a fleet of low-cost SO-101 cells under light on-site supervision. v0.1 validates this arm farm end to end and compares 7 policies across 12 tasks with both single-arm and bimanual configurations. Each policy is trained or fine-tuned on 50 demonstrations per task; the benchmark contains 2,518 policy rollouts and 600 reference demonstrations. All 3,118 episodes carry a three-way label (successful, suboptimal, or failure). Policy rollouts are human-scored, while demonstrations are successful by construction. Beyond evaluation, its quality-labelled trajectories support downstream learning, from reward and predictive world models to policies trained on mixed-quality data. The leaderboard is an initial comparison under this shared budget. We release the 3,118 core episodes in LeRobot v3.0 and RoboMeter formats.
tldr: ArmnetBench v0.1 presents a benchmark for evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies using a low-cost arm farm with 2,518 policy rollouts and 600 demonstrations across 12 tasks, releasing quality-labeled trajectories to support downstream learning.
tldr_zh: ArmnetBench v0.1 提出了一个使用低成本机械臂集群评估通用机器人操作策略的基准，包含 2,518 次策略部署和 600 次演示，覆盖 12 个任务，并发布质量标注的轨迹以支持下游学习。
summary_zh: 现实环境评估是开发通用机器人操作策略的瓶颈。每次任务部署都需要实体硬件及操作员进行设置、重置与评分。本文提出ArmnetBench v0.1基准测试，该测试在轻量级现场监督下运行于低成本SO-101单元集群。v0.1验证了该机械臂集群的端到端性能，并在12项任务中比较了7种策略（涵盖单臂与双臂配置）。每种策略基于每项任务50组演示数据进行训练或微调；基准测试包含2,518次策略部署与600组参考演示。全部3,118组样本均带有三类标签（成功、次优或失败）。策略部署由人工评分，而演示数据在设计上均为成功案例。除评估功能外，其质量标记轨迹可支持下游学习任务，涵盖奖励模型构建、预测世界模型训练以及基于混合质量数据的策略学习。排行榜展示了该共享预算下的初步比较结果。我们以LeRobot v3.0与RoboMeter两种格式发布了3,118组核心样本。

title: Continual-RL for Generalization in Autonomous Racing on the RoboRacer Platform
summary: A key challenge in modern robotics is to adapt to changing environments, a challenge that is exacerbated when simulations cannot encompass every possible real-world configuration, and therefore Reinforcement Learning (RL) in the physical world becomes necessary. Continual Reinforcement Learning provides the tools to address this challenge; however, both the frameworks and the methods remain underexplored. Autonomous Racing and in particular the RoboRacer competition provide a testing ground for such methods, as learning to drive on a new track-floor combination with the least amount of new experience naturally frames a continual learning problem. This work tries to address this gap by proposing a continual RL framework based on Continual Backpropagation that is able, with only real-world data, to train a generalistic policy on a set of tracks and then fine- tune it within 15 minutes to outperform classical controllers. Furthermore, a comparison method based on offline RL is proposed, and a simulation analysis of the plasticity properties of the methods is conducted.
tldr: This paper proposes a continual reinforcement learning framework based on Continual Backpropagation for autonomous racing, enabling real-world training and fine-tuning of a generalist policy on the RoboRacer platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于持续反向传播的持续强化学习框架，用于自主赛车，能够在RoboRacer平台上基于真实世界数据训练并微调通用策略。
summary_zh: 现代机器人技术面临的一个关键挑战是适应不断变化的环境，当仿真无法涵盖所有可能的现实世界配置时，这一挑战会更加严峻，因此在物理世界中进行强化学习变得必要。持续强化学习为应对这一挑战提供了工具，但其框架和方法仍有待深入探索。自动驾驶赛车，尤其是RoboRacer竞赛，为这类方法提供了试验场，因为在新的赛道-地面组合上以最少的新经验学习驾驶，天然构成了一个持续学习问题。本研究尝试填补这一空白，提出了基于持续反向传播的持续强化学习框架，该框架仅使用真实数据即可在一组赛道上训练通用策略，并在15分钟内完成微调以超越经典控制器。此外，本文还提出了一种基于离线强化学习的对比方法，并对各方法的塑性特性进行了仿真分析。

title: FloAff-Kitchen: Bridging Navigation and Manipulation via Canonical and Progressive Floor Affordance Learning
summary: Mobile manipulation requires robots to identify Floor Affordance (FloAff) that maximizes downstream manipulation success rather than merely ensuring navigation feasibility. FloAff prediction is a target-conditioned local spatial reasoning problem, yet existing methods suffer from representation ambiguity caused by irrelevant spatial context and arbitrary object orientations, while entangling shared and task-specific knowledge across heterogeneous manipulation skills. To address these challenges, we propose a unified framework for FloAff prediction from egocentric multimodal perception, consisting of canonical representation learning and progressive affordance prior learning. Specifically, we introduce a Canonical Floor Affordance Representation (CFAR), which learns canonical interaction geometry by preserving affordance-relevant local structure while eliminating nuisance spatial variations unrelated to robot base placement. We further propose Progressive Floor Affordance Learning (PFAL), which learns transferable FloAff priors from a foundation manipulation task and progressively adapts them to heterogeneous downstream manipulation skills. To facilitate systematic evaluation, we establish the first cross-scene, multi-view FloAff-Kitchen benchmark covering diverse manipulation skills, scene layouts, furniture styles, and viewpoints. Extensive experiments on three benchmark settings demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines, while ablation studies validate the contribution of each proposed component. Project page: https://csu-hero-lab.github.io/FloAff-Kitchen_Web/
tldr: A unified framework for floor affordance prediction in mobile manipulation that uses canonical representation and progressive learning to transfer knowledge across skills, outperforming baselines on a new benchmark.
tldr_zh: 一个用于移动操纵中地板可行区域预测的统一框架，通过规范表示和渐进学习实现技能间知识迁移，在新基准上优于基线方法。
summary_zh: 移动操作要求机器人识别能够最大化下游操作成功率的“地板可操作性”（FloAff），而不仅仅是确保导航可行性。FloAff预测是一个目标条件驱动的局部空间推理问题，然而现有方法因无关空间上下文和任意物体朝向而导致表示歧义，同时将共享知识与任务特定知识在异构操作技能中纠缠不清。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于自我中心多模态感知的统一FloAff预测框架，包含规范表示学习和渐进式可操作先验学习。具体而言，我们引入了规范地板可操作性表示（CFAR），通过保留与可操作性相关的局部结构同时消除与机器人基座放置无关的空间变异干扰，学习规范交互几何。我们进一步提出了渐进式地板可操作性学习（PFAL），从基础操作任务中学习可迁移的FloAff先验，并逐步将其适配到异构下游操作技能。为便于系统评估，我们建立了首个跨场景、多视角的FloAff-Kitchen基准数据集，涵盖多样化的操作技能、场景布局、家具风格和视角。在三个基准设置上的大量实验表明，我们的方法一致优于强基线模型，而消融研究验证了各提出组件的贡献。项目页面：https://csu-hero-lab.github.io/FloAff-Kitchen_Web/

title: Effective Parameters, Real Behavior: Renormalization for Robotics -- From Infinite Electron Mass to Sim-to-Real Gap
summary: Bridging the sim-to-real gap is a central problem in robotics, and the prevailing approach is to build increasingly accurate simulators. Here, we propose another approach based on renormalization: using effective, resolution-dependent parameters to absorb details omitted by the simulator and reproduce real behavior. These parameters may differ from measured physical values because they compensate for what the simulator leaves out. We demonstrate this mechanism analytically for proportional--derivative (PD) control at finite simulation frequency, where proportional feedback changes the effective derivative gain and derivative feedback changes the effective inertia. We then interpret dynamic rope manipulation and underwater swimming through the same perspective. Finally, we present a practical procedure for choosing observables, identifying omitted physics, and determining effective parameters. Renormalization offers robotics a complementary path across the sim-to-real gap: effective parameters, real behavior.
tldr: This paper proposes renormalization as a method to bridge the sim-to-real gap by using effective, resolution-dependent physical parameters that absorb simulator omissions, demonstrated analytically for PD control and practically for rope manipulation and underwater swimming.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于重正化理论的方法来弥合仿真与现实的差距，通过使用有效且依赖于分辨率的物理参数来吸收模拟器忽略的细节，并在PD控制、绳索操作和水下游泳中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 跨越仿真与现实的鸿沟是机器人学的核心问题，当前主流方法致力于构建日益精确的仿真器。本文提出另一种基于重整化的方法：利用有效且依赖于分辨率的参数，吸收仿真器忽略的细节并再现真实行为。这些参数可能与实测物理值存在差异，因为它们补偿了仿真器遗漏的部分。我们通过有限仿真频率下的比例-微分（PD）控制对该机制进行解析论证，其中比例反馈改变有效微分增益，微分反馈改变有效惯性。随后从同一视角解读动态绳索操控与水下游泳问题。最终提出一套选择可观测量、识别遗漏物理过程并确定有效参数的实用流程。重整化为机器人学跨越仿真与现实的鸿沟提供了一条互补路径：有效参数，真实行为。

title: WARL: Wrench-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Task-Agnostic Learning in Legged Robots
summary: While reinforcement learning for legged robots has achieved high motor performance, it has been constrained by the limited exploration capability of actions confined to the joint space. To address this issue, this study proposes a new method, Wrench-Augmented Reinforcement Learning (WARL), which introduces a wrenche (force and torque) into the action space. The proposed method combines wrench-guided exploration with a success rate-based curriculum mechanism to expand exploration capabilities in the early stages of learning, with the ultimate goal of acquiring behaviors based solely on joint control. Experiments using a quadruped robot demonstrated that WARL can learn robustly across diverse terrains and motor tasks without requiring terrain-specific reward adjustments or complex curriculum designs. Furthermore, an ablation study verified the effectiveness of the Switching Curriculum, which gradually eliminates the wrench. On the other hand, we also show that introducing a wrench can encourage behaviors that do not sufficiently exploit the robot's physical embodiment. These findings suggest that while wrench-based exploration enhancement is effective for improving learning efficiency, designing it in a way that is consistent with the robot's physical structure is a critical future challenge.
tldr: Proposes Wrench-Augmented Reinforcement Learning (WARL) that adds force/torque to the action space with a curriculum mechanism to improve exploration for legged robot locomotion, demonstrating robust task-agnostic learning on a quadruped.
tldr_zh: 提出WARL方法，将力/扭矩加入动作空间并结合课程机制，以扩展四足机器人强化学习的探索能力，实现跨地形鲁棒的任务无关学习。
summary_zh: 尽管基于强化学习的腿式机器人已实现较高的运动性能，但其动作空间受限于关节空间的探索能力。为解决该问题，本研究提出了一种新方法——力旋量增强强化学习（WARL），该方法将力旋量（力和力矩）引入动作空间。所提方法将力旋量引导的探索与基于成功率的课程机制相结合，以扩展学习初期的探索能力，最终目标是通过仅依赖关节控制来习得行为。在四足机器人上的实验表明，WARL无需针对特定地形调整奖励或设计复杂课程，即可在多样化地形和运动任务中实现鲁棒学习。此外，消融实验验证了逐步消除力旋量的切换课程的有效性。另一方面，我们也发现引入力旋量可能导致机器人未能充分利用其物理本体特征的行为。这些结果表明，尽管基于力旋量的探索增强能有效提升学习效率，但如何使该设计符合机器人物理结构特性仍是未来面临的关键挑战。

title: Moving-Horizon Estimation and Nonlinear Model Predictive Control of Cable-Driven Soft Manipulators
summary: Precise control of soft manipulators remains challenging due to the difficulty of developing accurate yet computationally tractable models for model-based estimation and control. Reduced Cosserat-rod models provide a physics-based and control-oriented description of soft-robot dynamics, offering an explicit alternative to purely data-driven input-output representations. In this paper, we propose a moving-horizon estimation (MHE) and nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) framework for cable-driven soft manipulators based on reduced Cosserat dynamics. A smooth cable-length-driven modeling formulation is developed by approximating the complementarity relationship between cable tension and cable slackness, enabling cable-length control without direct tension sensing. Based on this formulation, an MHE method is introduced to estimate the reduced state and reconstruct the manipulator configuration from end-effector pose measurements and cable-length information. An NMPC controller is then formulated to achieve task-space control under cable-length and cable-rate constraints. The proposed framework is validated through numerical simulations and experiments. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the estimator and controller for pose and strain-related regulation on a multi-cable soft manipulator. Experimental results on a four-cable prototype further show that the proposed MHE-NMPC scheme can be implemented in real time and enables accurate end-effector position tracking through cable-length control.
tldr: This paper presents a moving-horizon estimation and nonlinear model predictive control framework for cable-driven soft manipulators using reduced Cosserat-rod dynamics, validated in simulation and on a real robot prototype.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于缩减Cosserat动力学模型的缆索驱动软体机械臂的移动视界估计与非线性模型预测控制框架，并通过数值仿真和实物实验验证了其有效性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
由于难以开发既精确又计算高效的模型用于基于模型的估计与控制，软体机械臂的精确控制仍面临挑战。简化Cosserat杆模型为软体机器人动力学提供了基于物理且面向控制的描述，是纯数据驱动输入-输出表示的显式替代方案。本文针对绳驱动软体机械臂，提出一种基于简化Cosserat动力学的滚动时域估计（MHE）与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）框架。通过逼近绳张力与绳松弛之间的互补关系，建立了一种平滑的绳长驱动建模方法，从而无需直接张力感知即可实现绳长控制。基于该建模方法，引入MHE方法以估计简化状态，并利用末端执行器位姿测量值和绳长信息重构机械臂构型。进一步设计NMPC控制器，在绳长与绳速约束下实现任务空间控制。通过数值仿真与实验验证了所提框架的有效性。仿真结果展示了该估计器与控制器在多绳软体机械臂位姿及应变相关调节中的性能。基于四绳原型的实验进一步表明，所提MHE-NMPC方案可实时实现，并通过绳长控制达成精确的末端执行器位置跟踪。

title: Bridging Reinforcement Learning and Optimal Control via Feasible Action Mapping
summary: Operating constrained dynamical systems requires controllers to efficiently solve complex tasks while enforcing recursive feasibility and safety constraints. To address these competing requirements, we present Feasible Action for Optimal Control (FAOC), a novel control framework integrating Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Optimal Control (OC). The key contribution is a computationally efficient, optimization-based mapping algorithm that transforms the RL agent's action from a static abstract set into a state-dependent feasible parameter set of the Optimal Control Problem (OCP), guaranteeing strict satisfaction of the dynamical system's constraints. Thus, FAOC effectively combines the predictable safety of OC with the flexibility of RL. In contrast to prior work, the abstract action space of the RL agent does not require expert or heuristic design, and the OCP formulation is not compromised by the inability of RL to guarantee feasibility. We apply our approach to real-time motion planning for robot table tennis, which encapsulates these challenges. Via simulated experiments, we show that FAOC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both sample efficiency and closed-loop performance.
tldr: FAOC integrates RL and optimal control by using an optimization-based mapping to guarantee constraint satisfaction, demonstrated on robot table tennis.
tldr_zh: FAOC 通过优化映射融合强化学习与最优控制，确保约束满足，并在机器人乒乓球任务中验证。
summary_zh: 操作受约束动态系统需要控制器在确保递归可行性与安全约束的前提下，高效解决复杂任务。为应对这些相互竞争的需求，我们提出了面向最优控制的可行动作（FAOC），一种融合强化学习与最优控制的新型控制框架。其核心贡献在于：通过一种计算高效、基于优化的映射算法，将强化学习智能体的动作从静态抽象集合转换为与状态相关的最优控制问题可行参数集，从而严格满足动态系统的约束条件。因此，FAOC有效结合了最优控制的可预测安全性与强化学习的灵活性。与以往研究不同，强化学习智能体的抽象动作空间无需专家或启发式设计，且最优控制问题的公式化表述不会因强化学习无法保证可行性而受损。我们将该方法应用于机器人乒乓球实时运动规划——该问题集中体现了上述挑战。通过仿真实验表明，FAOC在样本效率与闭环性能方面均优于现有最优基线方法。

title: Memory for Attention: Language-Conditioned Re-Perception with a Vision--Language--Motion Map
summary: A robot carrying a persistent, behavior-annotated map faces two planning questions, and its memory answers only one well. The \emph{spatial-navigation} question -- how to walk around a room -- we address first and report a negative: building on Vision--Language--Motion Maps (VLMM), a behavior-aware planner cost cuts a planning-time objective by $\sim$35\% over 28 AI2-THOR scenes, but under closed-loop execution the real benefit nearly vanishes ($\sim$4\%) and an on-demand vision--language model (VLM) does as well. The \emph{resource-allocation} question differs: under a limited perception budget, what should the robot re-observe now to keep its map fresh? Framing re-perception as this attention decision, we show a persistent map's memory (change-history, or even just recency of last sighting) yields the best schedule (held-out), matching an oracle, while the memoryless VLM prior is poor. Because the schedule reallocates budget toward what matters, memory's benefit concentrates on the important objects ($\sim$1.6$\times$ the mean), and a downstream fetch task confirms fewer wasted trips; the gain grows with per-instance heterogeneity exactly as a Cauchy--Schwarz bound predicts -- it equals $\mathrm{Var}(\sqrtλ)$, the variance of root-volatility. With a real CLIP prior on rendered objects the advantage is $+21$--$26\%$. The map's distinctive value appears when the task is \emph{language-conditioned}: told what to track, VLMM grounds the relevant objects (open-vocabulary) and tracks their change (memory), beating even a strong relevance-weighted recency baseline ($+2.5\%$) -- so its motion channel adds value beyond a last-seen timestamp -- and an on-demand VLM ($+8.9\%$); neither language nor dynamics alone suffices. The map earns its keep not by telling the robot how to walk around a room, but by telling it what to pay attention to.
tldr: A persistent, behavior-annotated map (VLMM) helps a robot decide what to re-observe under a limited perception budget by using memory (change-history or recency), yielding significant gains in language-conditioned re-perception and downstream fetch tasks, but offers negligible benefit for spatial navigation.
tldr_zh: 一个持久化、行为标注的地图（VLMM）帮助机器人在有限的感知预算下决定重新观察什么，通过使用记忆（变化历史或最近观察时间），在语言条件重感知和下游取物任务中取得了显著收益，但在空间导航方面收益甚微。
summary_zh: 携带持久性、行为注释地图的机器人面临两个规划问题，而其记忆系统仅能妥善回答其中之一。针对第一个"空间导航"问题——如何在房间内移动——我们首先进行了探究并报告负面结果：基于视觉-语言-运动地图（VLMM），行为感知规划器成本在28个AI2-THOR场景中使规划目标降低了约35%，但在闭环执行下其实际优势几乎消失（约4%），按需调用的视觉语言模型（VLM）也能达到同等效果。"资源配置"问题则截然不同：在有限感知预算约束下，机器人应重新观测哪些内容以保持地图时效性？通过将重新感知行为框架化为注意力决策，我们证明持久性地图的记忆（变化历史，甚至仅基于最近观测时效）能产生最优调度方案（保留验证集），其表现与理想预测模型持平，而无记忆的VLM先验表现不佳。由于该调度机制将预算重新分配至关键目标，记忆的优势集中在重要物体上（约为均值的1.6倍），下游抓取任务进一步验证了无效行程的减少；随着实例异质性增加，增益严格遵循柯西-施瓦茨不等式预测——等于根波动率的方差Var(√λ)。在基于渲染物体的真实CLIP先验下，优势提升21%-26%。当地图任务变为"语言条件化"时，其独特价值显现：在被告知需追踪目标后，VLMM能锚定相关物体（开放词表）并追踪其变化（记忆），甚至超越强相关性加权时效基线（+2.5%）——其运动通道在最后观测时间戳基础上提供了额外价值——以及按需VLM（+8.9%）；单纯语言或动力学信息均无法达成此效果。地图的价值不在于指引机器人如何行走，而在于告诉它应当关注什么。

title: MulRobBench: A Decision-Level Benchmark for Safe and Security-Policy-Compliant Multimodal UAV Agents
summary: Smart-city airspace is transforming Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from passive sensing platforms into cyber-physical decision makers that must follow operational rules under degraded observations and ambiguous language. Existing UAV and multimodal benchmarks evaluate perception, navigation, collaboration, and reasoning, but few assess whether physical evidence, protocol constraints, and action risk remain coupled during critical decisions. We introduce MulRobBench, an offline, protocol-conditioned benchmark for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) UAV agents in smart-city environments. MulRobBench integrates real UAV multimodal observations, protocol-level security policies, and action-level cyber-physical safety into a unified evaluation framework. The benchmark contains 3,024 samples spanning 17 task taxonomy nodes and 12 scoring dimensions across four stages: operational context understanding, multimodal evidence arbitration, degradation-aware reasoning, and risk-aware action planning. Evaluation combines semantic scoring with structural diagnostics, including policy compliance, format compliance, unsafe actions, parsing failures, and dimension-level validity. Across 17 multimodal models, the best semantic protocol-decision score reaches only 0.5141, while the best strict mean scoring-dimension accuracy is 0.1599. A controlled 20-anchor modality-ablation study changes 4-15 action selections per model, confirming that both visual and textual inputs influence decisions. Analysis identifies modality-trust selection, constraint extraction, glare, missing data, and operator shorthand as the primary causes of decision instability. MulRobBench provides a reproducible benchmark for trustworthy multimodal UAV decision making under realistic operational constraints.
tldr: This paper introduces MulRobBench, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language-action (VLA) UAV agents on safe and security-policy-compliant decision-making under degraded observations and ambiguous language, finding that current models perform poorly.
tldr_zh: 这项工作提出了 MulRobBench，一个用于评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）无人机代理在退化观测和模糊语言下进行安全且符合安全策略决策的基准，结果表明当前模型表现不佳。
summary_zh: 智慧城市空域正将无人驾驶飞行器（UAV）从被动感知平台转变为遵循退化观测与模糊语言操作规则的信息物理决策者。现有UAV与多模态基准测试评估了感知、导航、协作与推理能力，但鲜有关注关键决策过程中物理证据、协议约束与行动风险是否保持耦合。我们提出MulRobBench——面向智慧城市环境下视觉-语言-动作（VLA）UAV智能体的离线协议条件化基准测试。该基准将真实UAV多模态观测、协议级安全策略与动作级信息物理安全整合至统一评估框架，包含涵盖17个任务分类节点与12个评分维度的3024个样本，分设操作语境理解、多模态证据仲裁、退化感知推理与风险感知行动规划四个阶段。评估结合语义评分与结构化诊断，包括策略合规性、格式合规性、不安全行为、解析失败与维度级有效性。在17个多模态模型中，最佳语义协议决策得分仅为0.5141，最佳严格平均评分维度准确率为0.1599。受控的20锚点多模态消融研究使每个模型产生4-15个动作选择变化，证实视觉与文本输入均影响决策。分析识别模态信任选择、约束提取、眩光、数据缺失与操作员简写为决策不稳定性的主因。MulRobBench为现实操作约束下可信多模态UAV决策提供了可复现的基准测试。

title: Learning Adaptive Multi-Task Guidance, Navigation, and Control via Hypernetworks
summary: Autonomous free-flying robots in orbital environments require controllers that are both versatile and resource-efficient, yet maintaining a separate, task-specific policy for each mission profile is architecturally brittle and limits operational flexibility as requirements evolve. We introduce HYPER-GNC, a multi-task reinforcement learning framework in which a hypernetwork maps physics-informed task embeddings to the weights of a shared actor-critic policy, enabling a single compact controller to master four distinct GNC tasks: velocity tracking, docking, inspection, and navigation with obstacle avoidance. The continuous embedding space allows the controller to generalize to novel mission configurations at deployment time without any retraining. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HYPER-GNC achieves sample efficiency comparable to single-task specialists while maintaining stability under significant inertial perturbations and external body wrenches. We further validate the framework on a physical satellite emulator, successfully bridging the simulation-to-reality gap across all mission profiles. Code, trained models, and deployment scripts are made publicly available to support reproducibility.
tldr: A hypernetwork-based multi-task RL framework (HYPER-GNC) for orbital free-flying robots that enables a single controller to handle velocity tracking, docking, inspection, and navigation, and generalizes to new missions without retraining.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于超网络的多任务强化学习框架（HYPER-GNC），用于轨道自由飞行机器人，使单个控制器能够执行速度跟踪、对接、检查和导航，并在无需重新训练的情况下泛化到新任务。
summary_zh: 在轨道环境中，自主自由飞行机器人需要兼具通用性与资源效率的控制器。然而，针对每种任务剖面维护独立的专用策略在架构上缺乏鲁棒性，且随着需求演进会限制操作灵活性。我们提出HYPER-GNC，一种多任务强化学习框架，其中超网络将物理信息任务嵌入映射到共享的演员-评论家策略权重，使得单个紧凑型控制器能够掌握四种不同的制导导航与控制任务：速度跟踪、对接、巡检及避障导航。连续嵌入空间使控制器能够在部署时无需重新训练即可泛化至新型任务配置。大量实验表明，HYPER-GNC在显著惯性扰动与外部力矩干扰下仍能保持稳定性，其样本效率可与单任务专家相媲美。我们进一步在物理卫星模拟器上验证了该框架，成功弥合了所有任务剖面的仿真到现实差距。代码、训练模型及部署脚本已公开以支持可复现性。

title: Not Forgotten: Implementation and Evaluation of a Personalized Episodic Memory for the Humanoid Robot Head Kim
summary: Social robots that rely on large language models for conversation are unable to retain information across sessions. This absence of memory violates social expectations, potentially preventing the formation of persistent relationships. This paper presents a lightweight episodic memory module that integrates vector-based semantic retrieval with an LLM-controlled dialog system, deployed on the humanoid robot head Kim. The module employs a hybrid scoring function combining cosine similarity with a memory strength metric to retrieve contextually relevant past interactions and inject them into the generation prompt. The system was evaluated in a within-subjects video-based online study (N = 43) using the Human-Robot Interaction Evaluation Scale (HRIES). Results show that episodic memory significantly increased perceived sociability (d = 0.60, p < .001), with the strongest effects on perceived trustworthiness (d = 0.62) and warmth (d = 0.56). Perceived disturbance remained unchanged (d = 0.00), indicating that the implemented approach to personalized recall did not trigger privacy-related discomfort or uncanny valley effects. These findings suggest that episodic memory serves as a social lubricant in embodied Human-Robot Interaction, enhancing relational quality without eliciting negative affective responses.
tldr: This paper presents a lightweight episodic memory module for the humanoid robot head Kim that integrates vector-based semantic retrieval with an LLM-controlled dialog system, and shows through a video-based user study that it significantly improves perceived sociability and trustworthiness.
tldr_zh: 本文为类人机器人头部 Kim 实现了一个轻量级情景记忆模块，结合向量语义检索与 LLM 控制的对话系统，并通过视频用户研究表明该模块显著提升了感知社交性和可信度。
summary_zh: 依赖大型语言模型进行对话的社交机器人无法跨会话保留信息。这种记忆缺失违背了社交预期，可能阻碍持久关系的建立。本文提出了一种轻量级情景记忆模块，该模块将基于向量的语义检索与LLM控制的对话系统相结合，部署在类人机器人头部Kim上。该模块采用混合评分函数，结合余弦相似度与记忆强度度量，以检索上下文相关的过往交互信息，并将其注入生成提示中。通过一项基于视频的受试者内在线研究（N=43），采用人机交互评估量表（HRIES）对系统进行评估。结果表明，情景记忆显著提升了感知社交性（d=0.60，p<0.001），其中对感知可信度（d=0.62）和温暖感（d=0.56）的影响最为显著。感知干扰度保持不变（d=0.00），表明所实现的个性化回忆方法并未引发隐私相关不适或恐怖谷效应。这些发现表明，情景记忆在具身人机交互中充当社交润滑剂，在提升关系质量的同时不会引发负面情感反应。

title: Mutual Modality Trust with Lightweight Reconstruction Regularization for Fine-grained Tire Pattern Recognition
summary: Visual tire recognition serves as a core supporting technique for vehicle safety monitoring, autonomous driving perception and automated automotive maintenance. Existing fine-grained tire recognition techniques suffer from three prominent limitations. They tend to depend on only one visual source, lack the capacity to jointly model spatial and frequency cues for minute tread texture extraction, and suffer severe overfitting given limited annotated tire imagery. This paper proposes a lightweight fine-grained tire pattern recognition method incorporating dual-branch independent inference and enhanced feature fusion to boost recognition performance. The framework employs two task-specialized branches dedicated to tire surface and tread indentation, respectively, to extract modality-specific discriminative features. Each branch conducts independent prediction, while cross-branch feature fusion exploits Mutual Modality Trust (M$^2$T) to realize complementary feature enhancement across two modalities. Besides, a frequency-domain hierarchical guidance module is devised, which leverages bandpass filters to decompose feature maps into high- and low-frequency components and enables fine-grained cross-layer feature modulation. Furthermore, a Lightweight Reconstruction Regularization (LR$^2$) is introduced to retain abundant intrinsic information within feature embeddings, substantially improving feature stability and recognition robustness under limited labeled training data. In addition, we establish a surface-indentation multi-source dataset namely MTire299 for fine-grained tire tread recognition, which covers 299 categories with a total of 14795 paired image samples. Extensive experiments conducted on two public tire datasets validate the superiority and efficacy of the proposed algorithm.
tldr: A lightweight tire pattern recognition method that fuses surface and tread indentation cues via dual-branch inference, mutual modality trust, frequency-domain guidance, and reconstruction regularization, with a new 299-class dataset.
tldr_zh: 一种轻量级轮胎花纹识别方法，通过双分支推理、互模态信任、频域引导和重建正则化融合表面与胎面凹陷线索，并贡献了一个299类新数据集。
summary_zh: 视觉轮胎识别是车辆安全监控、自动驾驶感知和自动化汽车维修的核心支撑技术。现有细粒度轮胎识别技术存在三个显著局限：通常仅依赖单一视觉源、缺乏联合建模空间与频率线索以提取微小胎面纹理的能力，以及在有限标注轮胎图像下存在严重的过拟合问题。本文提出一种轻量级细粒度轮胎花纹识别方法，通过双分支独立推理与增强特征融合提升识别性能。该框架采用分别专用于轮胎表面和胎面压痕的两个任务专用分支，以提取模态特定的判别性特征。每个分支进行独立预测，而跨分支特征融合通过互模态信任机制（M$^2$T）实现两种模态间的互补特征增强。此外，设计了频域层级引导模块，利用带通滤波器将特征图分解为高频和低频分量，并实现细粒度的跨层特征调制。同时引入轻量级重建正则化技术（LR$^2$），保留特征嵌入中丰富的本征信息，在有限标注训练数据下显著提升特征稳定性与识别鲁棒性。为支持细粒度胎面花纹识别，我们构建了名为MTire299的表面-压痕多源数据集，涵盖299个类别共14795对配对图像样本。在两个公开轮胎数据集上的大量实验验证了所提算法的优越性和有效性。

title: A Case Study on the Acceptance of a Humanoid Robotic Head Employed in Three Public Spaces
summary: Previous research has shown that a human-like robot's acceptance heavily depends on the setting in which it operates and its ability to perform relevant tasks. This paper, first, reports on how our robot processes natural language to generate a multimodal, verbal response integrating emotional expressions based on an emotion simulation backend. Then, it describes how visitors were invited to speak with our robot in their own language at three different, public locations, where the robot was running continuously for several days. The TAM2 questionnaire results reveal that on average users were motivated to use the robot and found it rather useful and easy to use regardless of the specific location. However, public spaces like the tourist information and the city library seem to be a better fit for our interactive, robotic head than an office environment such as the building authority, where the willingness to interact was lower. Overall, the robot's multi-lingual responses were very much appreciated, but every fifth user found the response time too slow impeding the dialog flow, which remains to be improved in future work.
tldr: This paper evaluates public acceptance of a humanoid robotic head that processes natural language and displays emotional expressions across three public spaces, finding that location influences willingness to interact.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了一种能够处理自然语言并展示情感表情的人形机器人在三个公共场所的接受度，发现地点会影响交互意愿。

title: Self-Supervised Consistency Enhanced Disentangled Learning for Neural Decoding Generalization in Brain-Machine Interface
summary: Brain-Machine Interfaces (BMIs) provide a direct communication pathway between the brain and external devices, enabling humans to control assistive and robotic technologies, with potential applications in rehabilitation, human motor augmentation, and human-centered robotics. However, due to neural drift, the performance of BMIs decreases over time, posing challenges for long-term viability, particularly for invasive BMIs (iBMIs). Existing solutions suffer from two main drawbacks: (i) difficulty in learning robust neural representations, and (ii) neglecting that neural drift varies across motor parameters (e.g., velocity, direction, and speed). To overcome these limitations, we propose Self-Supervised Consistency enhanced Disentangled Learning (SSCDL), a neural decoding generalization framework built on two key innovations. We first design a backbone model named Consistency enhanced Neural Decoder (CND), using a novel teacher-student consistency constraint with simulated neural signal perturbations to learn robust representations invariant to neural drift. Then, we employ three dedicated CNDs under the Complementary-Disentangled Generalization (CDG) mechanism, which disentangles motor signals into velocity, direction, and speed with inspiration from neural preference theory. This disentangled learning enables SSCDL to capture invariant neural representations from diverse neural preference perspectives, significantly enhancing cross-day generalization. Extensive experimental results show that SSCDL delivers state-of-the-art decoding performance, exhibiting high robustness and cross-day stability. These capabilities underscore its strong potential for long-term interaction in human-centric robotic and fine-grained assistive applications.
tldr: SSCDL uses self-supervised consistency and disentangled learning to improve neural decoding robustness against neural drift, enabling long-term stable control for brain-machine interfaces in robotic applications.
tldr_zh: SSCDL通过自监督一致性和解耦学习提升神经解码对神经漂移的鲁棒性，为脑机接口在机器人应用中的长期稳定控制提供支持。

title: SHARE: Towards Head-Mounted AR with User-Centric SLAM in Shared Human-Robot Workspaces
summary: Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) in shared physical spaces using Augmented Reality (AR) interfaces is powered by Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). Existing multi-agent SLAM systems rely on an edge server to combine visual findings of multiple resource-constrained agents, perform computation, and schedule updates to their local maps. However, the edge treats all agents uniformly and ignores the fundamentally different latency requirements of heterogeneous HRC agents: robots and head-mounted AR users. This uniform resource allocation often results in high lag for user manipulation, as it does not meet the stringent latency requirements of AR. In this work, we design, implement, and evaluate SHARE, a user-centric SLAM system that strategically prioritizes AR user experience while maintaining accurate tracking performance for robots. SHARE builds a first-of-its-kind experience model for HRC agents and adaptively adjusts transmission priorities to match it. To reduce end-to-end latency, SHARE leverages the redundancy of visual features acquired by agents in shared human-robot workspaces to reduce computation time induced by edge-based processing. Real-world deployment with commercial AR headsets and a ground robot achieves 13.22 ms average latency for AR users (43.3% reduction from baseline) while maintaining sub-2-centimeter tracking accuracy. User studies further reveal statistically significant improvements in user perception.
tldr: SHARE is a user-centric SLAM system that prioritizes low-latency AR user experience in human-robot collaborative workspaces by adaptively scheduling transmission and exploiting visual feature redundancy.
tldr_zh: SHARE 是一种以用户为中心的 SLAM 系统，通过自适应调度传输和利用视觉特征冗余，在人与机器人协作工作空间中优先保证增强现实用户的低延迟体验。

title: Scaling GUI Agents with Visual State Transitions
summary: We introduce State Transition Pretraining (STP) as a new scaling axis for GUI agents. During the STP stage, we continually pretrain a unified multimodal model on visual state transitions by jointly optimizing inverse dynamics (predicting actions from state changes) and forward dynamics (predicting next states from current states and actions). This optimization equips the model with better action-grounded visual representations and an internal world model of GUI dynamics. When subsequently fine-tuned on trajectories with task instructions, our STP-trained models consistently outperform baselines trained solely via direct trajectory fine-tuning across agent benchmarks in both desktop and mobile GUI scenarios (AgentNetBench, AndroidControl, and GUIOdyssey). Further empirical studies show that joint dynamics optimization yields stable improvements over single-objective training, and downstream performance scales steadily with the volume of transition data.
tldr: This paper proposes State Transition Pretraining (STP) for GUI agents, which jointly optimizes inverse and forward dynamics to learn action-grounded representations and world models of GUI dynamics, leading to improved performance on desktop and mobile GUI agent benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出面向图形用户界面智能体的状态转移预训练方法，通过联合优化逆动力学和正动力学来学习动作导向的视觉表示和图形用户界面世界模型，在桌面和移动端基准测试上取得了更好性能。

title: Accuracy potential of visual localization exploiting high-end street-level imagery
summary: Accurate and reliable pose information with respect to a reference frame is increasingly demanded across applications such as autonomous navigation, surveying, robotics, and augmented and mixed reality. Visual localization can serve as a complementary positioning modality to GNSS, whose applicability and accuracy are often limited. Yet, the accuracy potential of visual localization has not been systematically investigated against survey-grade demands. This is mainly due to the lack of publicly available, large-scale outdoor datasets with ground-truth poses in the sub-centimeter range. In this work, we address both gaps. We introduce a scalable visual localization pipeline that employs precisely georeferenced, high-resolution street-level imagery directly as the scene representation. It combines prior-guided reference candidate selection with on-the-fly local Structure-from-Motion reconstruction and PnP-based pose estimation. We further present the FHNW Muttenz dataset, a real-world dataset covering a contiguous 10 km street network mapped in two mobile mapping campaigns approximately 1.5 years apart. It consists of high-resolution reference imagery and query sequences acquired by four different cameras across five representative scenes. All images are precisely co-registered, yielding 6-DoF ground-truth poses in the sub-centimeter range. Using this dataset, we evaluate the accuracy potential of visual localization. Our experiments demonstrate median pose accuracies in the range of 1-5 cm for translation and 0.05-0.1° for rotation, reaching as low as 1 cm and 0.03° under favorable conditions. These results show that visual localization can complement survey-grade GNSS positioning, paving the way for 3D geospatial data acquisition using consumer devices and fully automated georeferencing approaches. The dataset is publicly available at: https://fhnw-muttenz-vl-dataset.github.io/.
tldr: This paper presents a visual localization pipeline achieving sub-centimeter to centimeter-level accuracy using high-end street-level imagery, with a new dataset (FHNW Muttenz) providing sub-centimeter ground-truth poses for evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用高端街景图像实现厘米级精度的视觉定位流程，并发布了提供亚厘米级真实位姿标注的 FHNW Muttenz 数据集。

title: BC-NMPC: Battery-Constrained NMPC with Propulsion Prediction and Replanning for High-Speed Flight
summary: Trajectory tracking performance of Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) degrades during high-speed and agile flight due to the depletion of the battery and subsequent loss of maximum available thrust. In applications such as drone racing, the consequent trajectory tracking error leads to a collision with obstacles and a subsequent failure to complete the race. In this paper, we present a novel method for integrating battery and propulsion system models into a Nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (NMPC) framework to enable real-time prediction of the voltage, consumed current, power, and maximum available thrust of the platform. This enables our approach to account for the dynamic variations in the maximum available thrust of the UAV caused by battery discharge, allowing it to plan for the depleting thrust and improve trajectory tracking performance.
